{{Quote|General Ki-Adi-Mundi, the troops are ready for deployment.|Bacara|<ref name="To the Vanishing Point" />}}
The '''Galactic Marines''', originally known as the '''21st Nova Corps''' of the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army]], was an elite unit that was created as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] diversified during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they became known as '''Imperial Galactic Marines'''.

==Equipment==
===Specialized armor===
Galactic Marines wore special body armor with maroon [[Color/Legends|coloration]] &mdash; and a backplate of which protected them from light blaster fire. They were usually armed with [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blasters. The Marines were distinguished by their unique face covering: [[Synthmesh/Legends|synthmesh]] designed to keep out various hazards such as snow, sand, airborne fungus, and ash.<ref name="GTTGA" />

===Vehicles===
The Marines were known to utilize several [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] including the [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|Unstable Terrain Artillery Transports]], [[All Terrain Open Transport/Legends|All Terrain Open Transports]], and [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]]. These were painted with [[Color/Legends|purple]] markings to identify their [[Corps/Legends|corps]] affiliation.

==Training==
Under the leadership of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|CC-1138]], the 21st Nova Corps of the [[4th Sector Army]] was made independent and became known as the Galactic Marines.<ref name="DBB" />

[[File:Marines.png|thumb|250px|Commander Bacara leads the Galactic Marines during the Battle of Mygeeto.]]
The Marines were cross-trained to fight on a variety of environments in ground and space, making them extremely versatile. They specialized in boarding and capturing enemy starships as well as planetary assault, and were deployed on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]], [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].

Bacara demanded the absolute best of his men, and would tolerate nothing less, unilaterally reassigning marines who did not meet his high standards, much to the dismay of General Ki-Adi-Mundi. The two maintained a respectful but contentious relationship, right up until the end of the war.<ref name="DBB" />

==History==
At the [[Battle of New Bornalex]], the Galactic Marines made use of prototype [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|spacetrooper]] powersuits. Although the weapon systems on their new suits failed, the Marines continued to fight on. They engaged [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] in hand-to-hand combat, using the enhanced strength granted to them by their powersuits. Their actions at [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]] earned the Marines a fierce reputation, making them one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] most feared clone military units.<ref name="DBB" />

[[File:Rothax.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Galactic Marine in Imperial service.]]

Commander Bacara (CC-1138) and a squad of Galactic Marines fought alongside Ki-Adi-Mundi during the [[Battle of Mygeeto]]. After receiving [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Bacara and his squad turned on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and fired upon him. Although he was able to defend himself briefly, Ki-Adi-Mundi was overwhelmed by numerous blaster shots and killed.<ref name="ROTS" />

Following the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Galactic Marines became known as Imperial Galactic Marines. During the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they served as sentries in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and participated in the ceremonial parades. [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] [[Rothax]] was an Imperial Galactic Marine who operated out of the [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Imperial soldiers who fought valiantly in battle earned the right to receive Galactic Marine armor from Rothax. This armor would at times be painted in completely different colors, including blue, gray, and brighter shades of red. [[BO-661]] was another Imperial Galactic Marine who guarded an [[Detainment Facility|Imperial Detainment Facility]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], but he was killed by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent during that year's Empire Day festivities.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', clone troopers in Galactic Marine armor are known as "clone commanders," However, the ''Battlefront II'' clone pack by [[Hasbro]] identifies them as "Galactic Marines," so this might be a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]. They also use [[Chaingun/Legends|chainguns]] in the game, however are normally seen in the films using DC-15A blaster rifles and DC-15S blasters. The armor also shares a resemblance to the later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Snowtrooper armor/Legends|snowtrooper armor]].

In the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' game, miniatures representing the military group are called Elite Clone Troopers. The second edition of the figure is called a Galactic Marine.
